feature: FR-11: Xem lịch sử đơn hàng (Domain + Boundary)

unauthenticatedCase.title: Unauthenticated user visiting /profile sees login prompt and no order table

apiAuthCases.title: API Auth Boundary (missing token): GET /api/orders/my-orders returns 401 or 403
API Auth Boundary (invalid JWT): GET /api/orders/my-orders rejects tampered token

idorCase.title: Security Isolation (IDOR): User cannot fetch another user's order via GET /api/orders/:id

emptyOrderCase.title: BVA Lower Bound (0 orders): displays empty order history message
emptyOrderCase.expectedEmptyMessage: Bạn chưa có đơn hàng nào.

singleOrderCase.title: BVA Min Non-Empty (1 order): displays Mã ĐH, Ngày đặt, Tổng tiền, Trạng thái columns

bulkOrdersCase.title: BVA Large List (50 orders): renders all 50 order rows accurately

statusCases.title: Status Domain (pending): displays 'Chờ xác nhận' with yellow badge and cancel button
Status Domain (confirmed): displays 'Đã xác nhận' with indigo badge and cancel button
Status Domain (shipping): displays 'Đang giao' with blue badge and hides user cancel button per SRS
Status Domain (delivered): displays 'Đã giao' with green badge and no cancel button
Status Domain (canceled): displays 'Đã hủy' with red badge and no cancel button

amountBoundaryCase.title: BVA Order Amount (0 and 999,999,999): formats boundary totals without NaN

apiErrorFallbackCase.title: Negative API 500 Error: handles /api/orders/my-orders failure gracefully
apiErrorFallbackCase.expectedFallbackText: Bạn chưa có đơn hàng nào.

responsiveCase.title: Responsive Mobile Viewport (375x667): order history heading and table remain visible
